section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section presents the findings of a study on body appreciation, body weight satisfaction, and weight loss efforts among 326 middle-aged Saudi women. The study found low body appreciation and a high prevalence of obesity among participants. It also noted that body appreciation was negatively correlated with BMI, consistent with findings from other countries. The section highlights the importance of body image issues in Saudi Arabia and suggests implications for health educators.
